passages.text: Lina and her brother have a small garden behind their house. They grow tomatoes and green beans. Every afternoon, they give the plants water.

NOTICE
The music room is open after school on Wednesday. Students can sing or play easy songs there. You can bring a notebook. New students are welcome.

To: Deni
From: Arif

Hi Deni,
My family is at my aunt's house this weekend. We cook together and play games. The children help set the table. I am having a good time.
Arif
Near our school, there is a small food shop. It opens early, and people stop there on the way to work. The shop sells bread, fruit, and drinks. My mother buys milk there.
Last Saturday, Emi and her cousin went to a lake. They walked near the water and watched birds. They took photos and ate sandwiches before going home.

NOTICE
Come to Room 3 on Friday at 3 p.m. We will make small cards for our teachers. Paper and colored pencils are on the table. You can bring a friend.
On Monday, our class visited a farm. We saw cows and chickens. A farmer showed us how to give food to the animals. We asked questions and went back to school before lunch.
In the morning, the beach is quiet. Some people walk near the sea. At noon, more families come. Children play in the sand, and parents sit under umbrellas. In the evening, the beach is quiet again.

Hi Sinta,
I cannot meet you at the park today. My little brother is sick, so I need to stay home with him. Can we play tomorrow afternoon instead? Please send me a message.
Maya
Wash two tomatoes. Cut them into small pieces. Put the pieces in a bowl with rice. Mix them, then add a little salt. Your food is ready to eat.

To: Nisa
From: Rani

Hi Nisa,
I usually walk to school, but this week I take the bus. The road near my home is closed because workers are fixing it. I will walk again when the road opens.
See you tomorrow!
Rani

On Saturdays, many people visit the town hall. In the morning, children come to draw pictures. After lunch, older students practice music. In the evening, parents meet there to talk. People come for many reasons.

Yesterday, our class wanted to play football outside. It started raining, so our teacher took us to the hall. We played a word game and worked in small teams. We still had a fun afternoon, even without football.

NOTICE
The school shop will not open on Monday because the worker is away. Students can buy pencils and notebooks on Tuesday morning. If you need something on Monday, ask your teacher for help.

There is a little park next to our apartment. On weekdays, people walk there before work. On weekends, families bring food and children play. We go there when we want to rest outside. Many people enjoy this park.

On Friday, our class wanted to clean the school yard. At first, only four students came. We thought the job would take all afternoon. Then more classmates arrived with bags and gloves. Some picked up paper, and others moved dry leaves. We finished before lunch. The yard looked better, and we were happy because we worked together.

Hi Beni,
I wanted to cook dinner for my family on Sunday, but we had no eggs. I went to the shop, but it was closed. My sister helped me choose another meal. We made vegetable soup and ate it with bread. Everyone enjoyed dinner. I learned that changing a plan can be okay.
Raka

Last month, our school library had only six chairs. Teachers moved some books and added two long tables. Students can now sit together to read and do homework. The books are still the same, but more students come after class. The room is easier to use, and many students like the change.

NOTICE
Starting next week, the art club will meet on Thursday, not Tuesday. The art room is busy on Tuesdays now. The club will still start at three o’clock, and students should bring their pencils and paper. Please tell your friends about the change.

After school, Fadil saw his neighbor near the gate with two heavy bags. She tried to carry both, but one fell to the ground. Fadil picked it up and carried it to her door. His neighbor smiled and thanked him. The next day, she gave him a small card that said, 'Thank you for helping.' Fadil felt happy because he made her day easier.
